notes: All samples acid-stressed (pH 2.5 LB, 2 h) after growth to OD 0.6 in LB; no untreated sample, so is_control left out (wild type is the comparison baseline but is treated). Phase mid_exponential inferred from OD 0.6 in LB, kept because sampling is at 2 h. Complemented strains (hns KO + plasmid hns wt) set genotype_class multiple; K121Q/K121R complements point_mutation. Unsure: whether an inducer was used for the complementing plasmids (not stated, left out). TruSeq RNA kit named, rRNA removal not stated (left out).
